ModMetaData.name: Pawn Comp Profiler
ModMetaData.author: tallowbyte
ModMetaData.description:
Find out which mod makes your colonists slow.
Times every comp tick of every pawn and lists the slowest comp types, so you can see which mod's pawn comps cost the most.
Dev mode: Debug actions > Pawn Comp Profiler > Log slowest pawn comps. Turn timing off in Options > Mod settings > Pawn Comp Profiler.
Safe to add or remove mid-save. Source included.
